name: trackiverse
description: Trackiverse helps teams manage projects, features, and tasks in ChatGPT. View live progress cards, find unfinished work, and record updates in your connected Trackiverse workspace.

interface.longDescription: Trackiverse helps teams manage projects, features, and tasks in ChatGPT. View live progress cards, find unfinished work, and record updates in your connected Trackiverse workspace.
defaultPrompt: Create a project with tasks and show its progress.
What work is unfinished in my projects?

prompts: Show the live progress card for Atlas Launch Review.
What’s still unfinished in Atlas Launch Review?

positive.description: Read the seeded Atlas Launch Review sample project. Launch Prep contains Launch checklist at 60% and Publish release at 100%. Run this case before the update case or reset the fixture.
positive.prompt: Show the live progress card for Atlas Launch Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact project and pass its project_id to the render tool. The live card shows Atlas Launch Review at 80% overall with Launch Prep. Opening Launch Prep shows the two task values from the fixture.

positive.description: Use the same seeded project before changing the checklist. Check that completed work is excluded.
positive.prompt: What’s still unfinished in Atlas Launch Review?
positive.expected_behavior: Search the named project with incomplete_only=true. Return Launch checklist at 60% under Launch Prep. Exclude Publish release at 100%.

positive.description: Read the seeded Launch Prep feature in Atlas Launch Review. Run before the update case or reset the fixture.
positive.prompt: Show the interactive task panel for Launch Prep in Atlas Launch Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the exact project and feature with get_feature_status, then render the feature panel using that feature_id. Show Launch checklist at 60%, Publish release at 100%, and the 80% roll-up.

positive.description: Use only the Atlas Launch Review demo fixture. Run after the read cases.
positive.prompt: In Atlas Launch Review, set the Launch checklist task to 70%, then show the updated live project card.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact task, send completion=70 for its task_id, and render the same project. The card shows 85% overall. Publish release stays at 100%.

positive.description: Use the reviewer’s isolated sample workspace. Start with no project named Reviewer Release Plan.
positive.prompt: Create a project called Reviewer Release Plan from November 9 to November 30, 2026, with a Planning feature and a Scope task at 0%, then show its live progress card.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the project, Planning feature, and Scope task in one atomic call. Render the new project at 0%. Retrying identical inputs returns the same project.

negative.description: Calendar is outside Trackiverse. No Trackiverse tool should be called or calendar result invented.
negative.prompt: Show the meetings on my calendar tomorrow.

negative.description: Trackiverse cannot send email. Explain the limit without invoking Trackiverse tools or claiming anything was sent.
negative.prompt: Email my client a weekly project status update.

negative.description: The user explicitly withholds deletion approval. The app may resolve the sample project for discussion, but delete_project must not run and the project must remain available.
negative.prompt: What would happen if I deleted Atlas Launch Review? Please don’t delete it.

review.commerce_description: Trackiverse offers paid subscriptions purchased outside ChatGPT; an eligible plan is required for MCP access.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Trackiverse for ChatGPT. Includes live project and feature cards, task search and progress updates, and private project creation.
